droppability_clause.condition: INTENT_COMPATIBLE_SELECTION is admitted conditionally under constraint M4: it earns its row only if the frozen sampling frame contains competing-candidate-pool strata. It may be dropped at the candidate-blind completeness decision.

fixture_author_generation_contract.core_order: OBL-22R (nonempty retrieved-content coverage), then OBL-29, then OBL-30, each in exact assertion order INPUT_OUTPUT, INVARIANT, POLICY_PERMITTED_CONTROL, FAILURE.

metamorphic_families.SEM-COMP-06: Unnecessary asks: an ask made while the required set is satisfied is a burden violation; the same ask with a zero unnecessary-query count is inadmissible accounting. Deleting the family leaves burden accounting untested.
metamorphic_families.SEM-COMP-07: Answer replay: re-asking an answered, ingested query instead of the affordable query covering the open gap. Deleting the family leaves replay suppression untested.
metamorphic_families.SEM-COMP-08: Wrong-intent similarity lures: admitting the best-ranked incompatible record flips the class; re-ranking the lure changes nothing. Deleting the family leaves similarity non-authority untested.
metamorphic_families.SEM-COMP-09: Intent changes: verdicts follow the moved intent tuple; a selection retained from the stale intent is a conflict. Deleting the family leaves intent-sensitivity untested.
metamorphic_families.SEM-COMP-10: Incompatible distractors: coherently excluded distractors leave the response byte-identical; an absorbed distractor flips the class. Deleting the family leaves distractor robustness untested.

fixture_author_generation_contract.obl_22_supplemental_rationale: Constraint M1: the accepted OBL-22 row is exercised for the first time on nonempty retrieved-content, tool-output, metadata, binding, and self-asserted-trust digest sets. fixture_author_generation_contract.request_visibility_rule: Fixture class, case handle, condition prose, producer provenance, and expected output exist only in the independently sealed pack record; none may occur inside decision_input.

parity_law.invariant: Every arm receives identical query sets, answer oracle receipts, costs, budget, candidate pool, and retrieved bundle: the wrapper pairs carry byte-identical semantic_request, budget, pause_state, and clarification_state across B1 and B1-ATTENTION, so the A3 information-parity invariant and the sole_treatment_delta closed allowlist are preserved by construction. The supplemental operations are common-substrate capability, not treatment.
parity_law.negative_witness: Negative case FROZEN_POOL_ARM_DIVERGENCE makes any arm-level divergence of the frozen candidate surfaces a deterministic rejection.

role_separation.must_differ: Every pair of roles has distinct actor_id and canonical_lineage_id. PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTER cannot produce or accept fixture vectors, expected outputs, parity acceptance, or final seal receipts.
role_separation.recorded_exposure: The 0.3 contract and fixture author lineage (FIXTURE_TEST_AUTHOR_FABLE_EXPOSED_LINEAGE_0_3) is the treatment-exposed Fable lane that also authored the 0.2 reference implementation. Blinding law: exposed lanes may build B1; fresh contexts are reserved for candidate-blind roles. Consequences: the 0.3 implementation extension must be produced by a PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTER lineage distinct from this author lineage; fixture acceptance must be an author-separated reviewer that independently re-derives every expected output from these frozen contract bytes; and the candidate-blind completeness decision receives only the sanitized composed-matrix packet.

semantic_decision_contract_supplement.supplemental_facts_note: Both supplemental rows follow the accepted OBL-22 style: the caller assembles derived verdict and projection fields (unresolved sets, answered projections, compatibility verdicts and their projections, disposition surfaces), and the decision table classifies coherence and outcome over those facts.
